pkgmetadata.longdescription: A deliberately narrow LLM inference engine for Intel Arc GPUs. arcint runs three Qwen hybrid model families (GatedDeltaNet linear attention with a minority of full-attention layers) on two cards, delegating kernel work to the OpenVINO compiler stack while owning the serving loop, scheduler, KV and recurrent-state memory, prefix caching, and speculative decoding.

use.flag: Build the OpenVINO executor backend for serving models on Intel Arc
Require a Python interpreter for the shipped export_mtp.py tool
Build the test binaries and run the device-free ctest gate (requires python)
